result_text:
With `cancelPendingInvitationsOnReInvite: true`, re-inviting an email that already has a pending invitation now succeeds. The old invitation is marked `canceled` and a new `pending` one is created. The organization test file passes (95 passed, 1 todo), including a new test for this. I didn't run `pnpm typecheck`.

The fix is in `routes/crud-invites.ts`. The "already invited" check was throwing before the cancellation code could run. It now skips the error when the option is on.

I also made the cancellation apply to every pending invitation for that email, not just the first one.

With the option off, the `USER_IS_ALREADY_INVITED_TO_THIS_ORGANIZATION` error behaves as before. `resend: true` still reuses the existing invitation in both cases.

The new test in `organization.test.ts` checks that the second invite succeeds with a different `id`. It also checks that the list has exactly one pending and one canceled invitation. I didn't add a test for the option-off case, since the existing tests at lines 492 and 505 already check that error.

I didn't commit anything.
